translation: Gather the root in the second or eighth month, dry in the shade. (Averse to 茹, in dread of acorus 菖蒲, sargassum 海藻, and 牡 ...) Original text of the Benjing: Dang-gui (當歸), flavor sweet, warm. It chiefly treats cough and counter-flow ascent of qi, warm-malaria with chills and fever, the shivering [as if] in the skin, and women ...
